name: fanyi
description: Write to Claude Code in your own language while Claude works in English: prompts are translated to English, and each reply gets a streamed translation underneath.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key for the translation endpoint. You can also enter it in the settings pane (/fanyi settings), which keeps it in the macOS Keychain.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Initial API host; change it in the settings pane

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Initial model id; pick another from the list in the settings pane

disable_thinking.title: Disable reasoning
disable_thinking.description: Send thinking: { type: "disabled" } for faster translations. Turn off if your provider rejects the field.
